long_biography.plain_text:
Growing up beside Haifa's port, Eyal Ofer worked aboard his family's ships before joining the maritime business built by his father, Sammy Ofer. That practical exposure became the foundation for a career in vessel ownership, chartering and long-term investment.

In the early 1980s, Ofer turned to Manhattan and established the family's American property business. His development of 15 Central Park West with William and Arthur Zeckendorf became its defining project, combining luxury residences with an exacting approach to design and location. Global Holdings subsequently assembled commercial buildings, hotels and residential developments across major international cities.
